name: DiPT
summary: A rare psychedelic tryptamine closely related to DMT, with the interesting property of having little visual hallucinations, but strong auditory effects.
advisory: This is a very new substance with very little history of human use. It is recommended to start low and increase dosage slowly. The dosages given are tentative, further research is recommended and caution is advised.

pharmacology.text: DiPT binds to serotonin receptors including the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, 5-HT2C receptors among others. It is known to act as a full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors. The drug has weak activity at the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor. It is also a weak serotonin reuptake inhibitor. In contrast to many related drugs, DiPT does not interact with the rodent or human trace amine-associated receptor 1 (TAAR1).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It is taken orally, but can also be smoked. DiPT was encountered as a novel designer drug in 2005.

summaryZh: N,N-二異丙基色胺是一種色胺類致幻劑和迷幻藥物，會造成幻聽。

sideEffects.en: It has been little studied. Users report distorted hearing, ringing in the ears, nausea and body discomfort. Like other psychedelic tryptamines, it can also cause anxiety and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 目前相關研究很少。使用者回報的反應有聽覺扭曲、耳鳴、噁心與身體不適。與其他迷幻色胺類一樣，它也可能引起焦慮與意識混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前相关研究很少。用户回报的反应有听觉扭曲、耳鸣、恶心与身体不适。与其他迷幻色胺类一样，它也可能引起焦虑与意识混乱。

fact.en: Alexander Shulgin described DiPT in his book TiHKAL. It is unusual among psychedelics because its main effect is a distortion of sound, often heard as a drop in pitch, rather than visual change.
fact.zh: 亞歷山大．舒爾金在著作《TiHKAL》中描述過DiPT。它在迷幻藥中相當特殊，主要效果是扭曲聲音，常被形容為音調變低，而不是視覺變化。
fact.zhHans: 亚历山大．舒尔金在著作《TiHKAL》中描述过DiPT。它在迷幻药中相当特殊，主要效果是扭曲声音，常被形容为音调制低，而不是视觉变化。
